title: Logbook
summary: A private, offline-first journal with an AI companion that asks a daily question and remembers past entries and photos.
whatItIs: A private, offline-first journaling platform that links daily entries, moods, habits and an AI companion. I’m using it to explore how software can support autobiographical memory and self-reflection.
built: Daily entries, mood tracking and habits, all linked together.
An AI companion that asks a question each day and recalls past entries and photos.
Logging from Telegram, and Spotify listening history pulled into each day.
Offline sync, so it works without a connection.
Goals, a pomodoro focus space, and a “density map” of how my time splits across coding, fitness, faith, work and rest.
A Python FastAPI backend serving a modular vanilla JS frontend, with a CRT look and two Mt. Fuji themes.
next: Invite-only accounts for a few friends, each with a private Logbook
role: Founder and developer, three months of work so far
homeSummary: A private, offline-first journal with an AI companion.

title: ThinkNeuro research
summary: A bibliometric review of the 100 most-cited papers on detecting adolescent depression and anxiety with wearable nanotechnology and biofeedback.
whatItIs: My summer research internship at ThinkNeuro. Our team reviewed the 100 most-cited papers on using wearable nanotechnology and biofeedback to detect depression and anxiety in adolescents.
built: Ran a keyword-trend analysis on research from the 1980s to 2022 to map how neuroscience and psychiatry themes shifted.
Helped build the data visualizations for the team poster.
Presented at the ThinkNeuro research symposium.
homeSummary: Research on adolescent mental health, wearable nanotechnology and biofeedback.

title: Obstacle-avoidance robot
summary: A sensor-based robot that detects and steers around obstacles, built by a team of four that I led.
whatItIs: A sensor-based robot that detects obstacles and steers around them. We built it to put our classroom robotics into practice.
built: Wired the sensors to the motor control.
Debugged both the hardware and the code.
homeSummary: An obstacle-avoiding robot, built with a team of four.

title: Church Finder
summary: Find the churches near you, starting with every church in Addis Ababa.
whatItIs: An app that shows nearby churches and every church in Addis Ababa. Addis first, then other cities.
built: Early build in progress, made with AI coding agents (Claude and Codex) working on the same repo.
homeSummary: Finding nearby churches, starting in Addis Ababa.
